description: Prepares the user to give a presentation: pins down audience, goal, and time slot, builds a storyline and a slide-by-slide outline with one message per slide, writes speaker notes and talking points timed to the slot, and prepares for tough questions with a likely-questions list, crisp answers, and bridging lines. Use when the user has to present, pitch, give a talk, run a demo, report to leadership or a board, or asks for a slide outline, talking points, speaker notes, a rehearsal, or help anticipating difficult questions.
